Name: Beriah, Son of Ephraim
Summary: Son born to Ephraim after Ezer and Elead were slain, named Beriah because it went evil with his house.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:23: Son born to Ephraim after Ezer and Elead were slain, named Beriah because it went evil with his house.
LifeLesson: The mention of Beriah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
